svg.title: HA test dynamics and evidence
svg.desc: Combined test sequence with separate Container Apps readiness-withdrawal and PostgreSQL failover mechanisms. Shows acceptance thresholds, preview gates, random-campaign limits, and full-zone evidence boundary. Native editable vector shapes and text. Official Azure icons are embedded vector artwork from the Microsoft Azure icon library. Design source: docs/specification.md and DECISIONS-ACCEPTED.md.

g.text: Constant workload / bounded fault injection / automatic business recovery / write reconciliation
Continuous load: 20 business operations/s / 80% reads, 20% writes
Independent authenticated read/write canary every second. Journal operation IDs, raw HTTP attempts, acknowledgements, and checksums.
HA-COMBINED-001: stages 3-4 must overlap. Run HA-APP-001 and HA-DB-001 separately before enabling combined or random campaigns.
Replica readiness withdrawal / exact replica IDs recorded
Lab-only helper / no public fault route
Four surviving replicas carry the load.
TTL expiry restores readiness; verify the routing effect and final ready count.
Azure manages zone placement. Replica IDs have no asserted zone identity.
Chaos Studio Workspaces + Scenarios / PREVIEW / validate regional action schema
Stable service FQDN + private endpoint + TLS hostname validation
Discard broken pooled connections; refresh identity tokens. Server request/retry deadline: 5s.
Retry logical writes for up to 180s with the same operation ID; reconcile uncertain commits.
DB / combined: recovery <=180s to the start of a qualifying 60s window.
Zero lost acknowledged writes, logical duplicates, or checksum mismatches.
Unknown commit outcomes must be resolved. Verify fault cleanup and health.
Enable after deterministic + preview gates pass; lab targets are allowlisted.
Recorded seed / maximum 10 events and 60 minutes per campaign.
Random spacing 5-15 minutes, subject to cooldowns; one scenario at a time.
Withdraw at most 2 of 6 ready replicas for 5 minutes.
DB cooldown >=20 minutes + healthy standby. Verify combined-fault overlap.
24-hour lab lease applies. Suspension inhibits and cancels campaigns.
Require supported real-zone injection and affected-zone evidence. Without both, report BLOCKED. Component-test passes cannot establish full-zone resilience.
